pages.text:
今天是一个特别的日子——猪猪姐姐要过生日啦！
咘咘一大早就跑到客厅，看着沙发上放着一个长长的盒子，用紫色的蝴蝶结绑着。
"这是我们要送给猪猪的礼物哦！"妈妈蹲下来，摸摸咘咘的头。
pages.text_en:
Today is a special day — it's Zhuzhu's birthday!
Bubu ran to the living room early in the morning and saw a long box on the sofa, tied with a purple bow.
"This is the gift we're going to give Zhuzhu!" Mom knelt down and patted Bubu's head.

pages.text:
"叮咚——"门铃响了！
咘咘飞快地跑去开门。门外站着猪猪姐姐，还有猪猪的爸爸妈妈。
猪猪姐姐毛茸茸的，穿着一条蓝色的新裙子，笑得眼睛弯弯的。
"咘咘！我来啦！"
pages.text_en:
"Ding dong!" The doorbell rang!
Bubu ran to open the door. There stood Zhuzhu, along with her mom and dad.
Zhuzhu was fluffy and wearing a new blue dress, smiling with her eyes curved.
"Bubu! I'm here!"

pages.text:
两个小家伙拉着手跑进屋里。NOMI在桌上摆好了茶点，NONO飞到猪猪头顶叽叽喳喳地说："Happy Birthday!"
Coco从厨房端出一盘切好的水果，黄色围巾随着步伐一晃一晃的。
"Welcome, welcome!" Coco笑着说。
pages.text_en:
The two little ones ran inside hand in hand. NOMI had set up snacks on the table, and NONO flew to Zhuzhu's head chirping, "Happy Birthday!"
Coco carried a plate of sliced fruit from the kitchen, her yellow scarf swaying as she walked.
"Welcome, welcome!" Coco said with a smile.

pages.text:
猪猪爸爸和猪猪妈妈坐在沙发上，和爸爸妈妈聊天。爷爷端来了茶，奶奶摆好了水果。
"猪猪最近长高了好多呀！"爸爸笑着说。
猪猪妈妈点点头："是呀，能吃得很呢！"
pages.text_en:
Zhuzhu's dad and mom sat on the sofa, chatting with Bubu's dad and mom. Grandpa brought tea, and Grandma set out fruit.
"Zhuzhu has grown so much taller!" Dad said with a smile.
Zhuzhu's mom nodded, "Yes, she eats so well!"

pages.text:
咘咘和猪猪在房间里玩了好一会儿——搭积木、画画、给玩偶办茶话会。
猪猪搭了一座高高的城堡，咘咘在旁边画了一条大鱼。
"好大的鱼呀！"猪猪凑过来看。
咘咘神秘地笑了笑："嘿嘿，待会儿你就知道了。"
pages.text_en:
Bubu and Zhuzhu played in the room for a long time — building blocks, drawing, and having a tea party with stuffed animals.
Zhuzhu built a tall castle, and Bubu drew a big fish next to it.
"What a big fish!" Zhuzhu leaned over to look.
Bubu smiled mysteriously, "Hehe, you'll find out soon."

pages.text:
"猪猪，我们有一个礼物要送给你！"咘咘拉着猪猪的蹄子来到客厅。
那个长长的紫色盒子就摆在茶几上。
猪猪的眼睛一下子亮了："这……这是给我的吗？"
pages.text_en:
"Zhuzhu, we have a gift for you!" Bubu held Zhuzhu's hoof and brought her to the living room.
The long purple box sat on the coffee table.
Zhuzhu's eyes lit up at once. "This... this is for me?"

pages.text:
猪猪小心翼翼地拉开蝴蝶结，打开盒子——
里面是一根漂亮的紫色小鱼竿！亮亮的，细细长长的，像一根魔法棒。
"哇——！"猪猪开心得跳了起来，卷卷的白毛都一颤一颤的。
pages.text_en:
Zhuzhu carefully untied the bow and opened the box —
Inside was a beautiful purple fishing rod! Shiny, long and slender, like a magic wand.
"Wow—!" Zhuzhu jumped with joy, her curly white wool bouncing.

pages.text:
咘咘跑到自己的房间，拿出了她的黄色小鱼竿。
两根鱼竿并排放在一起——一根黄色，一根紫色，像两根彩色的魔法棒。
"现在我们都有自己的鱼竿啦！"咘咘兴奋地说，"以后我们一起去钓鱼好不好？"
猪猪用力地点头："好！我们一定要钓到好大好大的鱼！"
pages.text_en:
Bubu ran to her room and brought out her yellow fishing rod.
Two rods lay side by side — one yellow, one purple, like two colorful magic wands.
"Now we both have our own fishing rods!" Bubu said excitedly. "Let's go fishing together someday!"
Zhuzhu nodded eagerly, "Yes! We must catch a really really big fish!"

pages.text:
NOMI蹲下来，帮两个小家伙把鱼竿小心地收好。
"钓鱼要等天气好的时候去哦，"NOMI温柔地说，"今天我们先去给猪猪过生日吧！"
NONO在旁边拍着翅膀："走走走！吃饭吃饭！"
pages.text_en:
NOMI knelt down and helped the two little ones carefully put away the rods.
"We'll go fishing when the weather is nice," NOMI said gently. "Today let's celebrate Zhuzhu's birthday first!"
NONO flapped his wings beside them, "Let's go! Let's go eat!"

pages.text:
大家一起出发去餐厅。爸爸开着车，妈妈坐在旁边帮忙导航。咘咘和猪猪挤在后座，叽叽喳喳说个不停。
爷爷奶奶和猪猪爸妈坐另一辆车跟在后面。
Coco趴在车窗边看着外面的风景，NONO站在Coco头顶。
pages.text_en:
Everyone set off for the restaurant. Dad drove the car, and Mom helped navigate. Bubu and Zhuzhu squeezed in the back seat, chattering non-stop.
Grandpa, Grandma, and Zhuzhu's parents followed in another car.
Coco leaned against the car window watching the scenery, with NONO perched on her head.

pages.text:
餐厅里，圆圆的大桌子摆满了好吃的菜。妈妈早就订好了猪猪喜欢的菜，中间放着一个圆圆的蛋糕，上面有猪猪最喜欢的草莓和奶油花。
"这是Tina阿姨帮我选的蛋糕！"猪猪开心地拍起小蹄子。
爸爸帮忙插上蜡烛，一根一根，数了四根。
pages.text_en:
At the restaurant, the big round table was full of delicious food. Mom had ordered Zhuzhu's favorite dishes in advance, and in the middle sat a round cake topped with strawberries and cream flowers.
"Auntie Tina picked this cake for me!" Zhuzhu clapped her little hooves happily.
Dad helped put in the candles, one by one — four in total.

pages.text:
蜡烛点亮了，所有人围着猪猪唱起了生日歌。
"祝你生日快乐，祝你生日快乐——"
猪猪双蹄合十，闭上眼睛，认真地许了一个愿。
然后，"呼——"一口气把蜡烛全吹灭了！
大家一起鼓掌："猪猪生日快乐！"
pages.text_en:
The candles were lit, and everyone sang the birthday song around Zhuzhu.
"Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you—"
Zhuzhu pressed her hooves together, closed her eyes, and made a careful wish.
Then, "Whooo—" she blew out all the candles in one breath!
Everyone clapped together. "Happy birthday, Zhuzhu!"

pages.text:
吃完饭，服务员端上来一大盘冰糖草莓，红红的草莓外面裹着一层亮晶晶的糖衣，像一颗颗宝石。
咘咘和猪猪一人拿一串，"咔嚓"一口咬下去。
"好甜呀！"两个人异口同声，然后看着对方，哈哈大笑。
pages.text_en:
After the meal, the waiter brought a big plate of candied strawberries — red berries coated in a glistening sugar shell, like little jewels.
Bubu and Zhuzhu each took a stick and bit in with a "crunch."
"So sweet!" they said in unison, then looked at each other and burst out laughing.

pages.text:
最后，每个人还分到了一个小小的冰淇淋球。咘咘的是草莓味的，粉粉的。猪猪的是香草味的，白白的。
Coco舔着自己的巧克力口味说："This is the best birthday party ever!"
NONO站在冰淇淋杯边上偷偷啄了一口，赶紧飞走了。
pages.text_en:
Finally, everyone got a small scoop of ice cream. Bubu's was strawberry — pink and pretty. Zhuzhu's was vanilla — white and creamy.
Coco licked her chocolate one and said, "This is the best birthday party ever!"
NONO perched on the edge of the ice cream cup, sneaked a peck, and quickly flew away.

pages.text:
回家的路上，猪猪靠在妈妈怀里，手里还紧紧抱着那根紫色鱼竿。
"今天好开心……"猪猪的声音小小的，眼睛已经快睁不开了。
咘咘在爸爸的背上，也困了，但还是使劲挥挥手："猪猪再见！下次一起去钓鱼！"
pages.text_en:
On the way home, Zhuzhu leaned against her mom, still holding the purple fishing rod tightly.
"Today was so much fun..." Zhuzhu's voice was small, her eyes already half-closed.
Bubu, on Dad's back, was also sleepy, but still waved hard. "Bye-bye Zhuzhu! Let's go fishing next time!"

pages.text:
到家了。奶奶帮咘咘脱了鞋子，NOMI帮她换上睡衣。
咘咘躺在床上，抱着粉色小兔子，旁边放着她的黄色鱼竿。
"NOMI，我和猪猪约好了，要一起去钓好大好大的鱼呢。"
NOMI帮她盖好被子："那一定会很好玩的。晚安，咘咘。"
pages.text_en:
Back home, Grandma helped Bubu take off her shoes, and NOMI helped her change into pajamas.
Bubu lay in bed, hugging her pink bunny, with the yellow fishing rod beside her.
"NOMI, Zhuzhu and I promised to catch a really really big fish together."
NOMI tucked her in. "That will be so much fun. Good night, Bubu."

pages.text:
窗外月亮圆圆的。咘咘闭上眼睛，梦里有一片蓝蓝的湖，湖边站着她和猪猪。
一根黄色的鱼竿，一根紫色的鱼竿，在阳光下闪闪发亮。
"准备好了吗？"
"准备好了！"
两根鱼竿同时甩出去——
pages.text_en:
Outside the window, the moon was round and full. Bubu closed her eyes. In her dream, there was a blue lake, and she and Zhuzhu stood by the shore.
One yellow rod, one purple rod, sparkling in the sunlight.
"Ready?"
"Ready!"
Two fishing rods cast out together —
